item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

dialog.agent: What should change in the picture?
dialog.why: It asks the user what changes they want to the picture and waits for that information.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t create the edit because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was generated.

The planned look was a navy blazer, light blue shirt, neutral studio background, and soft lighting—while keeping your face natural and recognizable.

style.prompt: Make this portrait into a polished, photorealistic professional headshot. Preserve the man's identity, recognizable facial features, age, gray hair, and natural skin texture. Dress him in a well-fitted navy blazer over a crisp light blue collared shirt. Replace the kitchen background with a simple neutral gray studio background. Use flattering soft professional lighting, natural color, and a neat head-and-shoulders composition with direct eye contact. Subtle realistic retouching only; retain his authentic appearance.
